tab.description: Tab handle from browser_list_tabs (e.g. "T3"). Omitted: this session's tab — the active tab, claimed on first use and then kept.

locator.description: Find the element without a ref: {role, name?} (e.g. {role:"button", name:"Sign in"}), {text} (visible text), or {css} (a selector). Each may add nth (0-based) to pick one of several matches; exact:true with name or text means case-sensitive equality instead of a substring match. What a browser_snapshot shows (role and name) is what a locator matches.

ref.description: Element ref from browser_snapshot (e.g. "e12"). Pass ref or locator, not both.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file. Default false.

path.description: Absolute destination: a file path, or a directory to save under the suggested filename.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL; same-site paths of the logged-in site work, redirects are followed.

asRef.description: Return a [ref=eN] for a DOM element result, to act on it with the other tools.

expression.description: JavaScript to evaluate in the page. The last expression's value is returned; top-level await and a bare `return` both work.

failedOnly.description: Keep only network errors and responses with status >= 400.

filter.description: Match the URL: a case-insensitive substring, or /regex/flags when wrapped in slashes.

id.description: Show one request in full — headers and request-body summary — by its id from a previous listing.

includeHeaders.description: Keep the (redacted) headers on the returned entries. The printed table never shows headers — use `id` to read one request's headers.

limit.description: How many of the newest matching requests to print. Default 50.
